sources.snippet: the Paradise is an antenna on the right side with a dial, which can be turned to zoom in and out on the device's screen. The dial features a clear window on the outside, a printed pattern of two arrows facing opposite directions inside. This clear window also serves as a button, where holding it down brings the user to Lab Mode; though, it also functions the same as the B button in some menus and games. [...] ### Accessories[] [...] The Tamagotchi Paradise has a color-screen, and the shell bears a visual resemblance to the Tamagotchi Pix in many ways, sharing a similar overall size and having printed graphics for the cracked-egg screen borders. The top half of the shell also has a cracked-egg design and is colored differently from the rest of the shell body; though, unlike the Pix, it can be flipped open and reveals a dock port for connection similar to the Tamagotchi Osutchi and Mesutchi.
